author: Espoir School of Life
title: Hiring paid Storybook Illustrator
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project) Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. Espoir School of Life is a non-profit organization that provides free, inclusive, and liberating education alongside holistic community development programs for underprivileged children and their families in Siargao. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations. ✨ How to Apply: If you want to help us bring these island narratives to life, please fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your: • Contact Information • Portfolio Link • Expected Rate/Project Quotation We can’t wait to see your work! 🌴✨ Contact: bit.ly/espoir-SI
